---
title: "Tribunal Coverage"
description: "Per-tribunal upload coverage with date ranges."
output: /data/tribunal_coverage.json
format: array
---

Coverage de uploads ao Internet Archive por tribunal, incluindo contagens
de pendentes/ausentes e intervalos de datas uploaded.

```{sql}
SELECT
  tribunal,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ia_status = 'uploaded') AS uploaded,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE djen_status = 'available' AND ia_status != 'uploaded') AS pending,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE djen_status = 'absent') AS absent,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE djen_status = '' AND ia_status != 'uploaded') AS unknown,
  COUNT(*) AS total,
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ia_status = 'uploaded') / COUNT(*), 1) AS coverage_pct,
  MIN(date) FILTER (WHERE ia_status = 'uploaded') AS earliest_upload,
  MAX(date) FILTER (WHERE ia_status = 'uploaded') AS latest_upload
FROM manifest
GROUP BY tribunal
ORDER BY coverage_pct DESC, tribunal;
```
